requestedText: Register the provider-agnostic Telegram renderer in the Weekly Radar interface boundary.

evidence: The interface registration is a compile-time Rust module export with no runtime loading or dynamic reference mechanism.
The registration exposes only the repository-local renderer boundary; no publisher or external adapter is added.
The registration adds no telemetry, monitoring, delivery, HTTP, or provider integration.
The Contract declares the additive interface registration and excludes provider integration, architecture-test, and global-policy changes.
